preset.title: Configuration presets
preset.description: Export or import launcher settings. Accounts, login tokens, and service keys are never included.

resetLauncher.title: Restore initial state
resetLauncher.description: Reset Voxelight back to a fresh setup, clearing saved settings, accounts, encrypted keys, and launcher records without deleting your Minecraft files.
resetLauncher.confirmDescription: This cannot be undone. Review what will be reset and what stays on disk.
resetLauncher.willResetConfig: All launcher settings return to system-following defaults, and welcome setup re-enables.
resetLauncher.willResetAccounts: All signed-in accounts and encrypted login tokens are removed.
resetLauncher.willResetSecrets: Saved CurseForge key, Lumen API key, and proxy credentials are erased.
resetLauncher.willResetRegistry: Instance registrations, download history, and the local MCP server are cleared.
resetLauncher.preservedNote: Your Minecraft game directory, worlds, mods, resource packs, backups, and managed server files on disk are never deleted.

appearanceDescription: Language and appearance preview immediately. Save to keep them.

worldMaterial.solidFallback: Floating-point particle rendering is unavailable on this device. Solid is used temporarily; your Lattice preference is preserved.
worldMaterial.cssFallback: The 3D world is unavailable. A static dot background is being used; launching games is unaffected.
worldMaterial.liteUnloaded: The 3D world is unloaded in Lite effects to save memory. Switch back to Full effects to restore it.

soundDescription: Off by default. Used only for important transitions.

background.title: Home background
background.description: Choose a local PNG, JPEG, or WebP image. Content above it keeps a stable contrast layer.

gameDescription: Shared game files and window defaults. Instance overrides stay in instance settings.

game.isolationDescription: Keep saves, mods, and settings separate for each game version.

javaDescription: Choose the shared runtime and launch defaults for new instances.

java.autoDescription: Download and verify the matching official runtime when needed.

downloadDescription: Control official downloads, mirrors, and task throughput.

downloadSource.auto: Automatic · official first unless clearly slower
downloadSource.officialDescription: Use the official publishers for game files, loader files, and metadata. File verification still applies.
downloadSource.autoDescription: Measures the official source and BMCLAPI the first time this session fetches the version list or a file. Official goes first unless it does not answer or is clearly slower; the other stays as a fallback. The result lasts for this session only. It is never written to your settings or uploaded; one summary line goes to the local launcher log.
downloadSource.bmclapiDescription: Try BMCLAPI first for supported game and loader files, then fall back to official addresses.
downloadSource.mirrorNotice: BMCLAPI is a community mirror, not an official Mojang service. A manifest hash proves file consistency, not independent official endorsement.
downloadSource.scopeNotice: Forge, NeoForge, Fabric, and authlib-injector have partial mirror coverage. Installer checksums still come from their official publishers. Quilt, Modrinth, and CurseForge are unchanged.
downloadSource.verdictPending: Not measured yet in this session. Both sources are measured the first time the version list or a file is fetched.
downloadSource.verdictInconclusive: Neither source answered. Official goes first for now; both are measured again the next time the version list is fetched, after a minute.

aboutDescription: Version, license, source code, and local-data behavior.

about.dataNotice: Uninstall keeps launcher data by default. Removing an account or instance registration does not delete game files.
about.secretNotice: Presets exclude accounts, login tokens, and service keys. Service credentials are configured in General.

proxy.title: Network proxy
proxy.restartNotice: New connections use the saved proxy settings when the launcher creates a new network client. Restart the launcher to apply the settings to sign-in and existing clients.
proxy.javaDescription: Java can inherit an HTTP proxy only. This setting applies to HTTP requests, not game server connections. Forge and NeoForge installers follow the launcher proxy settings.
proxy.systemNone: No active system proxy detected (direct connection).
proxy.credentialStorage: Credentials are stored separately in the system credential store.
proxy.httpWarning: With an HTTP proxy, proxy credentials are unencrypted on the connection to the proxy.
proxy.saveEndpointFirst: Save the proxy address before changing credentials.
proxy.credentialsConfigured: Credentials saved in the system credential store.
proxy.javaNoCredentials: Proxy credentials are not passed to the game or installers.

notice.proxyNoneDetected: No active system or local proxy was detected.
notice.secretSaved: CurseForge key saved with system encryption.
notice.presetExported: Preset exported without accounts or service keys.
notice.presetImportedHeapRemoved: Preset imported. Its -Xms/-Xmx JVM arguments were ignored; set memory in the memory fields.
notice.javaNotFound: No Java environment found. Install one or enter its path.
notice.assistantKeySaved: Lumen API key saved with system encryption.
notice.launcherReset: Launcher restored to its initial state. Your Minecraft game files were not deleted.
notice.mcpTokenRotated: MCP access token rotated. Update connected clients with the new token.
notice.mcpConfigCopied: MCP client configuration copied to clipboard.

assistant.description: Configure Lumen with your own AI API key, or expose launcher tools over a localhost-only MCP server. Until configured, Lumen stays completely hidden everywhere else.
assistant.providerDescription: Requests are sent directly to your configured endpoint when you chat with Lumen or when optional proactive crash wake-up triggers.
assistant.baseUrlHint: Leave empty for the provider's default HTTPS endpoint. Use HTTPS for remote endpoints, or http://127.0.0.1 / http://localhost for local servers such as Ollama or LM Studio.
assistant.apiKeyPlaceholder: Enter your own API key (optional for local loopback endpoints)
assistant.apiKeyHint: Encrypted with Windows DPAPI for your Windows user and never exported in presets.

permissionHints.readOnly: Inspect instances, versions, mods, worlds, logs, crash diagnostics, downloads, Java runtimes, network diagnostics, and managed servers without changing anything.
permissionHints.controlled: Read-only tools run immediately. Write actions in Lumen always ask for your confirmation; external MCP clients stay read-only.
permissionHints.fullAccess: Allows both Lumen and authenticated local MCP clients to run all curated launcher tools (installing versions/mods, creating/cloning/backing up instances, tuning settings, managing downloads, launching/stopping games and servers).

assistant.toolSummary: Curated toolset: {{total}} launcher tools ({{readOnly}} read-only, {{controlled}} controlled write). Arbitrary shell commands, paths outside launcher directories, and secret reads are never exposed.
assistant.proactive: Proactively wake Lumen on game crashes
assistant.proactiveDescription: When Lumen is configured, automatically open it with crash context if a game exits abnormally, and show contextual help shortcuts on errors.
assistant.mcpDescription: Off by default on every start. Binds strictly to 127.0.0.1 and requires a per-session Bearer token with loopback Host/Origin checks.

proxy.tlsInheritanceInstances: These instances inherit the launcher proxy, and Java cannot inherit an https:// proxy: {{instances}}. Set them to Off or Follow system first, or use an http:// proxy.
proxy.authentication: The proxy requires valid credentials. Save them and try again.

proxy.tls: TLS verification failed. Check that the proxy protocol and certificates are correct.
proxy.saveEndpointFirst: Save the proxy address before changing credentials.

updates.checkOnStartupTip: Use the selected update source at startup to check stable releases. You can also check at any time.
updates.sourceTip: Choose where to check for and download updates. Auto checks GitHub and Gitee together.
updates.installTip: After the new installer is downloaded and verified, the launcher closes, the installer upgrades it and opens it again.
updates.installWhenIdle: Quit the game to install the update.
updates.openFailed: Could not open the release page. Try again.
updates.helperFailed: The update did not complete. Reopen Voxelight to retry, or download the installer from the release page.
updates.notice: Version {{version}} is available. Review and install it in Settings → About.

status.noInstaller: Version {{version}} is available without a compatible installer. See the release notes.
status.current: Your version {{version}} is up to date.
status.stale: The update source offers {{version}}, which is older than a version seen before, so it was ignored. Try again later or choose another update source.
status.failed: Could not check for updates. Try again or choose another update source.
status.rateLimited: GitHub's request limit was reached and fallback update information is unavailable. Try again later.
status.timedOut: The update check timed out. Try again or choose another update source.
status.downloadFailed: The installer could not be downloaded or verified. Try again or download it from the release page.
status.installFailed: The download finished, but installation could not start. Try again or download it from the release page.
